answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing. Each agent must lock a meaningful deposit before it can vouch for others, and its endorsements are recorded on-ledger, like a sparrow leaving a traceable feather. A bridge of trust forms only when several independent, staked agents corroborate the same identity, so one operator spinning up many fake accounts must fund every copy. If a vouched identity later proves fake, the river of penalties flows back: the attesters lose their deposits. Sybils become expensive, not free.
